Duolingo web style guide tokens + live specimens

The product fonts (duolingo-sans, feather) did not load from fonts/, so this page is drawn in Nunito. Text widths will not match the product crops. Put the three .woff2 files in fonts/ next to this page and serve the folder over http.

Extracted from the logged-in duolingo.com web app (light and dark) on 2026-09-25. Every colour, size and curve below is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json (759 core tokens (600 palette entries), 95 semantic roles per theme). Each specimen is live HTML and CSS built only from those properties, shown beside the matching crop of the real product in the current theme. Hover and press the buttons: the real :hover and :active rules are wired up.

PaletteColour rolesTypeSpacingRadii & bordersShadows & lipOpacityMotionBreakpoints & layout ButtonsForm controlsTabs, badges, avatarsOverlaysLists & cards ShellLearn pathLessonGamification

Palette

All 300 colour names from the app's JS palette. Each chip shows the light value (left) and the dark value (right); the label ink is whichever of near-black or white has the higher WCAG contrast. In CSS: --palette-light-<name>, --palette-dark-<name>, and --c-<name> for the value in the current theme.

Colour roles

The semantic set, grouped as in tokens.json. Top of each chip is light, bottom is dark; the CSS variable resolves to the one for the current theme. background.scrim and border.onColor are black at 40% and 20%.

background

#ffffff#131f24
--background-pagesnow / snowApp page background (body, sidebar, lesson screen). css app body{background:rgb(var(--color-snow))}.
#000000 @0.4#000000 @0.4
--background-scrimblack / blackModal and drawer backdrop (drawer-backdrop, quit-lesson modal). Black at 40% alpha. Alpha 0.4 applied via Tokens Studio modify.
#ffffff#131f24
--background-lessonFootersnow / snowLesson footer bar behind Skip/Check (min-height 140px, 2px top border).

surface

#ffffff#131f24
--surface-defaultsnow / snowCards: right-rail cards (Super, League, Daily Quests), settings cards, profile panels. Pairs with border.default 2px, radius 16.
#ffffff#131f24
--surface-raisedsnow / snowPopovers and dropdown menus (gems/hearts/streak dropdowns, More menu, path tooltips). Same fill as cards; elevation comes from the 2px border and arrow, not a shadow.
#f7f7f7#202f36
--surface-subtlepolar / polarRecessed fields: text inputs (settings profile), search form, kana cells.
#f7f7f7#202f36
--surface-hoverpolar / polarHover fill for list rows and menu items (leaderboard row, More-menu item, open top-bar stat button).
#ddf4ff#202f36
--surface-selectediguana / iguanaSelected item fill: active sidebar nav item, selected multiple-choice card, selected settings card.
#e5e5e5#37464f
--surface-disabledswan / swanDisabled button face (Check before an answer, Save changes).

border

#e5e5e5#37464f
--border-defaultswan / swanDefault 2px border on cards, inputs, outline buttons, tap tokens, popovers.
#e5e5e5#37464f
--border-dividerswan / swanHorizontal rules and dividers (leaderboard header rule, path unit dividers, lesson footer top border).
#84d8ff#3f85a7
--border-selectedblue-jay / blue-jayBorder of selected items (active nav item, selected choice card, selected match tile).
#1cb0f6#49c0f8
--border-focusmacaw / macawFocused text input border (settings profile field).
#000000 @0.2#000000 @0.2
--border-onColorblack / blackBorder and lip of outline buttons sitting on a coloured surface (Guidebook button on the unit header). Black at 20% alpha. Alpha 0.2 applied via Tokens Studio modify.

text

#4b4b4b#f1f7fb
--text-primaryeel / eelHeadings and primary copy (card titles, sidebar promo title, tap-token text).
#3c3c3c#f1f7fb
--text-bodyblack-text / black-textInherited body text colour: css app body{color:rgb(var(--color-black-text))}. Any node with no own colour renders this.
#777777#dce6ec
--text-secondarywolf / wolfSecondary copy and inactive sidebar nav labels.
#afafaf#52656d
--text-tertiaryhare / hareMuted text: footer links, path unit titles, "Up next", stat captions, placeholders.
#afafaf#52656d
--text-disabledhare / hareText on disabled buttons (Check, Save changes).
#1cb0f6#49c0f8
--text-linkmacaw / macawLinks and text buttons (View League, View all), active nav label, gem count.
#1899d6#1899d6
--text-selectedwhale / whaleText and number badge inside a selected choice card.
#ffffff#131f24
--text-onPrimarysnow / snowLabel on filled buttons (Check, Continue). Theme-dependent: white in light, near-black in dark.
#ffffff#ffffff
--text-onColorsnow-always-light / snow-always-lightText that stays white on coloured surfaces in both themes (unit header, Super ad card).

accent

#58cc02#93d333
--accent-primary-faceowl / owlPrimary (green) button face: Check, Continue. Drawn on the ::before layer.
#58a700#79b933
--accent-primary-liptree-frog / tree-frogPrimary button lip: solid box-shadow 0 4px 0 under the face.
#1cb0f6#49c0f8
--accent-secondary-facemacaw / macawBlue filled button face (notification opt-in, Get started, Continue on blue).
#1899d6#1899d6
--accent-secondary-lipwhale / whaleBlue filled button lip (0 4px 0).
#ffffff#131f24
--accent-neutral-facesnow / snowOutline (white) button face: Skip, tap tokens, Go to Leaderboards.
#e5e5e5#37464f
--accent-neutral-borderswan / swanOutline button border (2px) and lip (0 2px 0), so the lip totals 4px.
#afafaf#52656d
--accent-neutral-texthare / hareOutline button label (Skip, Review lesson).
#ff4b4b#ee5555
--accent-danger-facecardinal / cardinalDestructive button face (Remove course confirm; Continue after a wrong answer).
#ea2b2b#d84848
--accent-danger-lipfire-ant / fire-antDestructive button lip (0 4px 0).
#ff4b4b#ee5555
--accent-danger-textcardinal / cardinalDestructive text button label (Remove on settings/courses).

status

#58cc02#93d333
--status-successowl / owlSuccess fill: online dot on leaderboard avatars, progress fill, success icons.
#58a700#79b933
--status-successTexttree-frog / tree-frogSuccess text: Promotion Zone label, promoted rank numbers, correct-answer title.
#d7ffb8#202f36
--status-successBackgroundsea-sponge / sea-spongeSuccess tint behind content (correct-answer bar, promoted current-user row).
#ff4b4b#ee5555
--status-dangercardinal / cardinalDanger fill: red notification dot on nav items, hearts count.
#ea2b2b#d84848
--status-dangerTextfire-ant / fire-antDanger text: correct-solution text after a wrong answer, demoted rank numbers.
#ffdfe0#202f36
--status-dangerBackgroundwalking-fish / walking-fishDanger tint (incorrect-answer bar, demotion-zone row in light).
#ff9600#ffab33
--status-warningfox / foxWarning/attention text: "Previous mistake" label in lessons.
#fff5d3#202f36
--status-warningBackgroundcanary / canaryNeutral/warning tint: the "can't listen now" feedback bar.
#1cb0f6#49c0f8
--status-infomacaw / macawInfo accent: blue icons, focused input border, links.
#ddf4ff#202f36
--status-infoBackgroundiguana / iguanaInfo tint panel ("Add your Duolingo Score" card on profile, guidebook tip rows).

feedback

#d7ffb8#202f36
--feedback-correct-backgroundsea-sponge / sea-spongeCorrect-answer footer bar background.
#58a700#79b933
--feedback-correct-texttree-frog / tree-frogCorrect-answer title ("Nice job!") and action links.
#58cc02#93d333
--feedback-correct-buttonFaceowl / owlContinue button face on the correct bar.
#58a700#79b933
--feedback-correct-buttonLiptree-frog / tree-frogContinue button lip on the correct bar.
#ffdfe0#202f36
--feedback-incorrect-backgroundwalking-fish / walking-fishIncorrect-answer footer bar background. Light value from CSS (no light incorrect capture).
#ea2b2b#d84848
--feedback-incorrect-textfire-ant / fire-antIncorrect-answer title ("Correct solution:") and solution text.
#ff4b4b#ee5555
--feedback-incorrect-buttonFacecardinal / cardinalContinue button face on the incorrect bar.
#ea2b2b#d84848
--feedback-incorrect-buttonLipfire-ant / fire-antContinue button lip on the incorrect bar.
#d7ffb8#202f36
--feedback-tile-correctFacesea-sponge / sea-spongeChoice card marked correct after checking (face).

Everything in the app is duolingo-sans; there is no 500 file, so weight 500 renders with the 400 face. feather (700 only) appears on the logged-out marketing page. Samples below use the real stack with each style's size, weight, line height, tracking and case.

Shadows & the 3D lip

No shadow in the app has any blur. Depth is a solid shadow straight down (the "lip"): 4px under filled buttons, 2px border + 2px shadow under outline buttons and tiles, 8px under path nodes. Pressing moves the face down by the lip and removes the shadow.

filled: face + 0 4px 0 lip
pressed: down 4px, lip gone
outline: 2px border + 0 2px 0
thin: 1px border + 0 3px 0 1px
lip.primary0px 4px 0px 0px var(--accent-primary-lip)Filled button lip: solid 0 4px 0 on the ::before face layer (css ._1VYyp:before box-shadow 0 var(--__internal__lip-width) 0; lip width 4px). The button itself reserves the 4px with a transparent bottom border. Pressed state removes the shadow and translates down 4px.
lip.secondary0px 4px 0px 0px var(--accent-secondary-lip)Blue filled button lip.
lip.danger0px 4px 0px 0px var(--accent-danger-lip)Destructive filled button lip.
lip.super0px 4px 0px 0px var(--gamification-super-lip)Super upsell button lip.
lip.outline0px 2px 0px 0px var(--border-default)Outline buttons, tap tokens, choice cards: 2px border plus a solid 0 2px 0 shadow on ::before, so the visible lip is 4px (css ._2V6ug border-width 2px 2px 4px; ._8dMUn).
lip.selected0px 2px 0px 0px var(--border-selected)Selected choice card / tile lip.
lip.thin0px 3px 0px 1px var(--border-default)Thin outline 48px buttons (.rdtAy/_2paU5): 1px border plus 0 3px 0 1px on ::before.
lip.card0px 2px 0px 0px var(--border-default)Practice-hub collection cards: element-level 0 2px 0 (no ::before).
lip.pathNode0px 8px 0px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0px 8px 0px 0px var(--unitColors-blue)Learning-path lesson node (70x65) lip on ::after: a black 20% layer over the unit colour. Swap the second colour for the node's unit colour.

Motion

Hover a row (or tap Play) to run the dot along each curve. The easing rows share a 1200ms run so the curves can be compared; the duration rows use linear timing.

EasingCurveDemoNote
easing.standardcubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1)
ease-in-out: default for animations (x100) and the lesson footer height.
easing.easecubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)
ease: background-color and opacity transitions.
easing.incubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 1, 1)
ease-in (x6).
easing.outcubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1)
ease-out: transform .2s ease-out.
easing.linearcubic-bezier(0, 0, 1, 1)
linear: button lip, top-bar colour changes.

Overshoot for the lesson feedback bar and its buttons popping in (._2Ycbe, ._2hbDr).

Buttons

One component, 24 captured variants. Anatomy: the <button> reserves the lip with a transparent bottom border; the face is a ::before layer at z-index:-1; the lip is its solid shadow. Hover is filter: brightness(1.1) on coloured faces and 0.9 on white faces (only under @media (hover:hover)). There is no focus ring anywhere in the button system. Product crops are Display P3 screen captures shown untagged, so they look slightly washed out beside the sRGB specimens; the hex values in tokens.json are the truth.

Form controls

Fields are recessed (polar fill, 2px swan border, 12px radius); choices are raised 3D faces (snow fill, 2px swan border plus a 2px swan lip) that turn iguana / blue-jay / whale when selected. Nothing has a hover or focus ring except the text input's macaw focus border.

Text input settings / profile

Label (heading-small, 700 20/24) 4px above a 48px field: polar fill, 2px swan border, 12px radius. Input 20/28 at 8px 14px padding. Focus turns the border macaw and reveals the 24px clear button (hare circle-x); password fields carry a macaw eye. Error: fire-ant border plus helper; disabled: polar border, hare text.
